name: Deficit Push-Up
instructions: Place your hands on two low platforms or dumbbells, slightly wider than shoulders.
Assume a plank position with a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest below hand level, getting a deep stretch.
Press back up to full arm extension. The deficit increases range of motion.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Deficit Push-Up is an intermediate pushing exercise for the chest, performed with just your bodyweight. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
